OF ALL INBOUND AIRCRAFT TO CONTACT ROTHERA OPS ON THE DAY OF AND
BEFORE DEPARTURE TO ASCERTAIN DETAILS OF RWY AVAILABILITY. ANY

POINT OF SAFE RETURN PERIODS. FOR MORE INFORMATION CONTACT ROTHERA
OPS: ROPS(AT)BAS.AC.UK PHONE: 
+441223221670 OR +441223221673
